# Olivares AI Provider

Manage the Olivares AI control plane as code via its REST API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    olivares = {
      source = "olivaresai/olivares"
    }
  }
}

# Endpoint and api_token may also be supplied via the OLIVARES_ENDPOINT and
# OLIVARES_API_TOKEN environment variables (the api_token is sensitive — prefer
# the env var or a secret manager over a literal in source).
provider "olivares" {
  endpoint  = "https://127.0.0.1:8443"
  api_token = var.olivares_api_token

  # insecure_skip_verify = true  # only for the self-signed dev cert
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer API token. May also be set via OLIVARES_API_TOKEN.
- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the control plane API (e.g. https://127.0.0.1:8443). May also be set via OLIVARES_ENDPOINT.

### Optional

- `insecure_skip_verify` (Boolean) Skip TLS certificate verification (for the self-signed dev cert). Defaults to false.
- `tenant` (String) Tenant UUID sent as X-Olivares-Tenant. Omit when the token is tenant-bound. May also be set via OLIVARES_TENANT.
